bundle.longDescription: Network Diagnostics checks proxy lists on your own machine — HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 — grades anonymity against a judge endpoint, tests proxies against the site you actually need, and checks domain health (A, MX, SPF, DMARC). Your list never leaves your device. Free and open source (MIT).
bundle.shortDescription: Test proxy lists locally: speed, anonymity, target-site reachability, plus domain health.
